audit.why: Packet levelChart is [Vladimir, Vladimir, Skill, Skill, Skill, Yone, Vladimir]; the mirror explicitly set row 2 to Skill and row 6 to Vladimir, and whys[1], whys[3], whys[4] and whys[6] already read that way.
audit.corrected: Row 1 -> Vladimir (3/10), rows 2, 3 and 4 -> Skill (5/10), row 6 -> Vladimir (3/10), each as a matched full+content pair.

audit.whatIsWrong: The two-item phase claimed your side-lane pattern is at full power, which is the opposite of every other line on the page.
audit.why: spikes[3], late and whys[6] all say Vladimir out-scales; Hemoplague is a 120s teamfight amp and Sanguine Pool falls to 16s at rank 5.
audit.corrected: phases[6].why rewritten to name the amp, the 16s pool, and where your actual lead has to be cashed.

audit.whatIsWrong: Sanguine Pool was described as 'Dodges your combo' with no cooldown and no duration; Transfusion's heal cadence was never given.
audit.why: Sanguine Pool is 28/25/22/19/16s and untargetable for 2 seconds; Transfusion is 9/7.9/6.8/5.7/4.6s and heals him, which is what beats your chip.
audit.corrected: dosFull[0].d, dosFull[2].d, phases[2].why and breakdown.cooldowns rewritten with the real timers and the Grievous Wounds timing.
